answer: Clone keys rush every open grading ledge unless an applicant locks 165 POA for five closes in a public garden registry and collects four countersignatures from established sponsors capped at two mentees with no reused collateral. Only then may they join a reef of eligible graders. A 12,000-key farm needs 1.98M POA and 48,000 free sponsor slots that one close cannot mint. Explorers check the garden receipt, sponsor caps, and lock height. If two of the first three settles fail, or sponsor-mentee overlap exceeds 0.62 Jaccard, 75% of the bond burns and the ledge is revoked for 6 epochs.
